thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — NimbusCloud invited us to co-host a 45m webinar + virtual booth on May 14. They want a short live lab (15m) showing Redwood Dedicated + a hardware partner integration. Need speakers, run-of-show, and swag plan. @David Park any conflicts? :calendar:
David Park: I can MC and do a 7-8 min product intro. free that day. who is doing the live lab demo?
Alejandra Ruiz: I can own the live lab demo if Samir or infra can sign off on a small Dedicated pool for the rehearsal + attendee Q&A. need a fallback plan if GPUs flake.
Samir Patel: +1. I can stand up a 2-GPU Dedicated env for the run-through. recommend we build a fallback demo that runs on a quantized CPU fallback model. saves us if GPUs get noisy.
Maria Chen: Good — so plan A: Dedicated live lab on GPU. Plan B: quantized CPU demo showing degraded but acceptable latency. @Zuri please handle speaker invites (Nimbus + our SMEs).
Zuri Okafor: On it. I'll ping Nimbus PM and confirm their engineer and two customer speakers. also asking for co-branded slides. any constraints for slide deck?
David Park: Keep slides short: 10 min product + 15 min lab + 15 min customer panel + 5 min Q&A. we should call out model versioning, rollout safety, and cost controls (Redwood Optimize) briefly.
Alejandra Ruiz: For the live lab script: 1) quick infra checklist 2) deploy model variant 3) run a burst load to demo autoscale 4) show fallback to quantized variant 5) show latency/cost dashboard in Console. I'll draft bullets.
Samir Patel: I'll prep infra checklist and a small runbook. putting a couple of pre-warmed KV cache snapshots so first-gen latency is reasonable. also adding a safety toggle to force fallback during demo.
Maria Chen: Swag — Nimbus will ship attendee promo packs. We should bring a small sticker pack + 50 enamel pins for the virtual booth giveaway. shipping to US/EU warehouses. any customs folks to loop in? @Alejandra Ruiz can you file the EU customs docs?
Alejandra Ruiz: Yes, I'll coordinate with ops and file HS codes. need a packing list and values. Can marketing provide net weight and SKU list?
Zuri Okafor: Marketing will share the packing list by EOD tomorrow. Also proposing a tiny microsite for registration that includes partner logos and a link to the repo with demo code.
David Park: Rehearsal times: suggest tech check 2 days before (30m) and a full dress rehearsal 1 day before (45m). Tuesday/Wednesday windows?
Samir Patel: I can do Tue 11–11:45 PT for tech check, Wed 9–9:45 PT for dress. I'll attach a short runbook snippet for the tech check:
```
# Tech check checklist
- confirm Dedicated pool up & GPUs healthy
- deploy demo model tag: v1.2-demo
- pre-warm KV cache (script prewarm.sh)
- validate fallback path: set FALLBACK=true and run sample workload
- verify Console dashboard shows tokens & cost breakdown
```
Maria Chen: Perfect. Also: recording + transcripts required by Nimbus. let's capture the video, upload to S3, and share the link with partners. @deploy-bot can you trigger the recording and the post-event upload?
deploy-bot: scheduled: recording enabled for session 1738264000. post-upload to s3://redwood-events/nimbus-may14 will run after processing. :robot_face:
Alejandra Ruiz: One more thing — booth staffing for the virtual floor: can we staff 3 people for 2-hour window post-webinar for live Qs? Volunteers?
Zuri Okafor: I can cover first hour. David can stay for the Q&A and first hour of booth. Maria can backfill if needed.
David Park: I'll stay for the first hour and monitor chat. we should have canned answers for common infra/setup Qs. Alejandra can own the redirect to docs and repo.
Maria Chen: Great. I'll compile a short ops doc, assign owners, and send invites for rehearsals. thanks all — I'll post the runbook link and speaker invite threads after this. :thumbsup:
